ITEM-BY-ITEM FINAL CLOSEOUT

RULE: Work on ONLY ITEM 1 now.
Do not start Item 2 or Item 3.
Do not give me a narrative, plan, summary, percentage, or certification report.
EXECUTE → VERIFY → EVIDENCE.

==============================
ITEM 1 — AUTONOMOUS INDEPENDENT TASK
==============================

CURRENT STATE:
AUTONOMOUS_INDEPENDENT_TASK=BLOCKED

OBJECTIVE:
Convert this to:
AUTONOMOUS_INDEPENDENT_TASK=PASS

This must prove IVX IA itself can perform a real production-safe senior-developer task end-to-end without Rork being part of git, build, deployment, or runtime execution.

STEP 1 — AUTH/RUNTIME BINDING

Inspect the REAL execution context used by IVX IA.

Check whether the already-configured owner authentication can actually be consumed by the autonomous worker.

Check bindings for the existing authentication mechanisms, including whichever mechanism production actually uses.

DO NOT print secret/token/password values.

Report only:
AUTH_METHOD=
CREDENTIAL_PRESENT=true/false
CREDENTIAL_BOUND_TO_WORKER=true/false
AUTH_HTTP_STATUS=
AUTH_BINDING=PASS/FAIL

IMPORTANT:
Do NOT ask me to recreate or provide credentials merely because they are unavailable in your shell.

First distinguish between:

A. credential does not exist
B. credential exists but is not injected into this shell
C. credential exists in production but worker binding is broken
D. credential exists and works
E. credential is rejected with real 401/403

If the credential exists in the application/runtime but is not available to the worker, FIX THE BINDING.

Only request owner intervention if real execution proves the credential itself is missing, revoked, expired, or rejected.

STEP 2 — EXECUTE REAL AUTONOMOUS TASK

After auth works, have IVX IA create ONE small, production-safe, independently verifiable improvement.

The autonomous IVX workflow itself must perform:

diagnose
→ modify code
→ run tests
→ create direct GitHub commit
→ push directly to GitHub
→ CI
→ merge if required
→ direct Render deployment
→ wait for deployment
→ /health verification
→ /version verification
→ functional verification

Rork must NOT manually perform the coding/deployment on behalf of IVX.

STEP 3 — PROVE EXECUTION

Capture:

TASK_ID=
JOB_ID=
AUTH_METHOD=
FILES_CHANGED=
TEST_COMMAND=
TEST_RESULT=
COMMIT_SHA=
GITHUB_SHA=
CI_RUN_ID=
CI_RESULT=
DEPLOY_ID=
RENDER_SHA=
HEALTH_SHA=
VERSION_SHA=
FUNCTIONAL_TEST=
RORK_RUNTIME_CALLS=
RORK_GIT_CALLS=
RORK_DEPLOY_CALLS=

Required:

TEST_RESULT=PASS
CI_RESULT=PASS
FUNCTIONAL_TEST=PASS

COMMIT_SHA == GITHUB_SHA
GITHUB_SHA == RENDER_SHA
RENDER_SHA == HEALTH_SHA
HEALTH_SHA == VERSION_SHA

RORK_RUNTIME_CALLS=0
RORK_GIT_CALLS=0
RORK_DEPLOY_CALLS=0

STEP 4 — NEGATIVE CONTROL

Attempt one unauthorized request against the protected autonomous execution endpoint.

Required:
UNAUTHORIZED_HTTP_STATUS=401 or 403

Then perform the authorized autonomous request.

Required:
AUTHORIZED_HTTP_STATUS=2xx

This proves authentication is actually enforced rather than bypassed.

STEP 5 — RESULT

Return ONLY:

ITEM_1=AUTONOMOUS_INDEPENDENT_TASK

AUTH_METHOD=
CREDENTIAL_PRESENT=
CREDENTIAL_BOUND_TO_WORKER=
AUTH_HTTP_STATUS=
AUTH_BINDING=

TASK_ID=
JOB_ID=
FILES_CHANGED=
TEST_RESULT=
COMMIT_SHA=
GITHUB_SHA=
CI_RUN_ID=
CI_RESULT=
DEPLOY_ID=
RENDER_SHA=
HEALTH_SHA=
VERSION_SHA=
SHA_PARITY=
FUNCTIONAL_TEST=

UNAUTHORIZED_HTTP_STATUS=
AUTHORIZED_HTTP_STATUS=

RORK_RUNTIME_CALLS=
RORK_GIT_CALLS=
RORK_DEPLOY_CALLS=

ITEM_1_RESULT=PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

If PASS:
STOP.

Print exactly:
ITEM_1_COMPLETE_READY_FOR_ITEM_2

If BLOCKED:
provide ONLY:
BLOCKER=
FAILED_OPERATION=
HTTP_STATUS=
EXACT_ERROR=
EXECUTION_CONTEXT=
REQUIRED_FIX=

Do not proceed to Item 2.

NO fabricated evidence.
NO historical SHA as current evidence.
NO simulated deployment.
NO claiming PASS from local tests alone.
NO asking for credentials until runtime binding has actually been tested.
